# Ultimate Guide to the CaloriTrack Nutrition Module

## What is this section for?

The Nutrition module is the metabolic heart and main command center of CaloriTrack, meticulously designed to transform food logging into a smart, guided, and frictionless experience. Its purpose is to empower the user by giving them absolute control over their daily intake, going far beyond simple calorie counting. 

This section works as a digital pocket nutritionist: it allows you to manage personalized meal plans, evaluate the exact balance of macronutrients in real-time, ensure the intake of vital micronutrients, and monitor antinutrient limits. In short, it is the ultimate tool to plan, log, and audit every aspect of your daily nutrition, ensuring you reach your health goals (lose, maintain, or gain weight) with precise data, reliable databases, and a highly visual and intuitive interface.

---

## üìÖ 1. Main Navigation and Calendar

Upon entering the **Nutrition** tab (identified by the fork and knife icon), the header offers total control of your timeline:

* **Swipeable Weekly Calendar:** At the top, you will find a horizontal date carousel.
* **Date Selection:** You can swipe left or right to travel in time, reviewing past days or planning future ones.
* **Logging Indicators:** Days that already contain logged foods will show a small colored indicator dot (Mint Green for past/today, or Sky Blue for future days) below the number.
* **Haptic Feedback:** Tapping any day generates a slight tactile vibration to confirm the selection.

## üìã 2. Your Meal Plan (Management and Wizard)

Just below the calendar is the Plans section, which is highly dynamic:

### If you don't have an active plan
* You will see an attractive card (**"Discover your Ideal Plan"**).
* Tapping it will open the 5-step wizard.
* **Steps 1 to 4:** You will configure your goal (lose, maintain, or gain weight), physical activity level, dietary restrictions (dairy-free, gluten-free, etc.), and your diet philosophy (Keto, Vegan, Paleo, etc.).
* **Step 5:** The system will recommend the perfect plans from the catalog for you to activate.

### If you have an active plan
You will see a swipeable two-page card:
* **Page 1:** Shows your plan's name, an icon representing your goal (e.g., down arrow for weight loss), and a progress bar indicating what day of the plan you are on.
* **Page 2:** If you swipe, you will see the exact calorie and macronutrient goals that plan requires.

### Plan Management
Tapping the **"Manage"** button opens a full panel:
* **Grocery List:** You can see the necessary ingredients per week, organized by category, and even select ingredients to export or share as text.
* **Weekly Menu:** Opens the generated menu to see what dishes you have scheduled each day. Tapping a dish will show its detailed recipe.
* **Change or Cancel:** You have dedicated buttons to abandon the current plan and start a new one.

## üìä 3. Daily Summary Cards (Paginator)

The control center for your intake. Swipe horizontally to toggle between three critical views of your daily data:

### Card 1: Macros Summary
* Shows your total calorie consumption on the left with a gradient-colored progress ring.
* On the right, you will see individual progress bars for your **Proteins** (Blue), **Fats** (Golden Yellow), and **Carbs** (Green).
* Tapping this card takes you to the **Daily Progress**, where you can see a bar chart summarizing your entire week.
* Tapping the "info" button opens the nutrition summary tooltip, which explains CaloriTrack's nutrition philosophy.

### Card 2: Micronutrients
* Gives you a quick glance at 5 essential minerals and vitamins: Potassium, Sodium, Vitamin D, Iron, and Zinc.
* Tapping the card opens the detailed view, where you can review dozens of vitamins and minerals, filter them by "Completed" or "Missing", and see your weekly averages.

### Card 3: Antinutrients
* An advanced metric that monitors compounds like Oxalates, Phytic Acid, and Lectins.
* Unlike nutrients (where you want to reach the goal), antinutrients use reverse bars: they will turn orange or red if you exceed healthy limits.
* Entering the detail view allows you to see your weekly history and read the app's scientific blog to understand their impact.

## üçé 4. The Diary: Food Logging and Management

This is the area where your entered foods appear.

* **Custom Organization:** At the end of the list, a button (**"Adjust meals"**) lets you choose how many meal blocks you want to see in your day: 4 (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack), 3, 2, or a single meal if you practice OMAD.
* **Meal Header:** Shows the name (e.g., "Breakfast") with its emoji and the total calories for that block.
    * On the right, it has an **Options menu** (three dots). It's a super-fast tool that allows you to: "Copy from yesterday", "Copy to yesterday", "Copy to tomorrow", or "Edit/Delete".
* **Food Display:**
    * *Individual Foods:** You will see the name, grams/portions, and exact calories.
    * *Dishes:* If you logged a complete dish, you will see the main name and a dropdown button. Tapping it expands to reveal all the individual ingredients that make it up.
* **Certifications:** Foods have trust icons: A seal indicates the information was verified by CaloriTrack, and a globe indicates it comes from public databases like the USDA.
* **Edit and Delete:** Tapping a food takes you to the screen to edit its quantity or move it to another meal. You can also swipe or long-press to delete it.

## üîò 5. The Floating Button (Search and Catalog)

To add new foods, the system uses a floating button in the bottom right corner so it's always accessible. It contains two shortcuts:

### Dish Catalog (Book Icon)
* Opens the beautiful visual gallery featuring our curated recipes.
* You can filter the gallery by diet type using the top buttons (e.g., "Ketogenic", "Vegan").
* Tapping a dish lets you see its full-screen photo, ingredients, and a massive nutritional summary before confirming if you want to add it to your log.

### Smart Search ("+" Icon)
* Opens the super search bar.
* **Text Search:** Search live in the CaloriTrack and USDA databases.
* **Barcode Scanner:** An icon next to the search bar opens your camera to scan physical products.
* **Recent History:** If the search bar is empty, it will show your "Recent Foods" for one-tap logging.
* **Create Private Food:** If you can't find something, you can tap the "Create private food" button (when the search shows "No results") to open the form and permanently save the nutritional facts of your own product.

---

:::warning Access Requirement (Premium Paywall)
The entire Nutrition module is an exclusive feature. If you do not have an active Premium subscription, the application will automatically present a paywall. This persuasive message explains the deep benefits of the module and invites you to subscribe to unlock your health's maximum potential.
:::-----

# Frequently Asked Questions

## üìÖ Daily Logging and Meal Organization

### I only see the "Lunch/Meal" option in my diary, where are "Breakfast", "Dinner", and "Snacks"?

CaloriTrack adapts to your lifestyle. If you only see one meal, you likely have the "1 Meal (OMAD)" preference set. To see the rest, go to the bottom of your nutrition diary, tap the button with the grid icon, and select your preferred structure (4, 3, 2, or 1 meal a day). Your diary will update automatically.

### I always eat the same breakfast. Do I have to search and log my eggs and oatmeal every day? 

Not at all! You have tools to speed this up. In the meal header (e.g., "Breakfast"), tap the three-dot menu (or options button) and select "Copy from yesterday". Also, when logging a food, you can use the "Add to multiple days" section to select it for the whole week at once.

### I logged a food under "Dinner" but it was for "Lunch", do I have to delete it and search for it again?

 No need. Simply tap the food you mistakenly logged in your diary. On the edit screen, look for the "Log Details" section and change the selector from "Dinner" to "Lunch". Tap save and it will move automatically.

### How do I delete a food or a complete meal that I logged by mistake?
 You have a couple of options. You can long-press the food or meal and select "Delete" from the dropdown menu. If you are in edit mode, you can tap the red minus icon next to the food.

---

## üîç Search, Scanner, and Private Foods

### I scanned a barcode but the app says the food was not found. What do I do?
 Although our database is huge, some local or very new products might be missing. When this happens, the screen will show you a button to "Create private food". There you can enter the name, brand, and main macros (calories, proteins, fats, and carbs) from the product's label. Once saved, you can log it immediately and it will be saved for your personal use.

### In the search results, what does the blue checkmark icon versus a world icon mean?
 It's an indicator of trust. The blue checkmark (seal) means the food is "Certified by CaloriTrack"; meaning, our database has validated it. The world icon indicates that the food comes from a public database, like the USDA.

### I entered the "Meal Catalog" but I only want to see low-carb options. Is that possible?
 Absolutely! At the top of the Meal Catalog, you will find a scrollable bar with different "pills" or tags. Simply swipe, find the "Low Carb" option and tap it; the grid will immediately filter for compatible options.

---

## üéØ Goals, Macros, and Progress

### My calorie and macro goals changed on their own and now it won't let me edit them manually. Why?
 This happens when you activate a Meal Plan. The system prioritizes the specific goals required by the plan so you can reach your objective. If you prefer to have full manual control of your calories and macros again, you must go to your Active Plan card, select "Manage", and then "Cancel Current Plan".

### I don't like counting grams, I prefer to adjust my macros by percentages (e.g., 40% protein, 30% fat, 30% carbs). Where do I do this?
 Go to the "Adjust Goals" screen, tap the visual Macros card (Proteins, Carbs, Fats) and an adjustment sheet will open. At the top, change the input mode from "Grams" to "Percentages". The system will calculate the exact grams for you based on your total calories.

### I eat differently on weekends, can I have a different calorie goal for Saturday and Sunday?
 Yes. In your goals settings, toggle the "Customize goals by day" switch. This will enable a new option called "Edit Weekly Goals", where you can set specific calories and macros for each day of the week independently.

### In my "Weekly Calorie Summary", I see the bars change color. What does that indicate?
 The bar chart is a traffic light for your adherence. If the bar is Mint Green, it means you achieved your goal or stayed below your limit. If the bar turns Orange, it means you exceeded your caloric goal for that day.

---

## ü•ó Micronutrients and Antinutrientes

### What is the "Antinutrients" card and why do some bars turn red?
 Antinutrients are compounds found in foods (mainly vegetables, seeds, and legumes) that can interfere with the absorption of vitamins and minerals if consumed in excess. If the bar is Green, your intake is low and safe. If it turns Orange, you are approaching the tolerable limit. If it is Red, you have exceeded the recommended daily limit (e.g., high oxalate consumption).

### I want to see if I met my Potassium goals for the whole week, not just today. Is that possible?
 Of course. Enter the details by tapping the "Micronutrients" card. At the top, below the title, you will see a selector that says "Today" and "7 Days" (or Weekly). Select the weekly view and the system will show you the average consumption of the last few days compared to your daily goal. You can also filter only the "Missing" nutrients to see which ones to focus on.

---

## üìã Meal Plans and Grocery Lists

### I activated a plan, where do I find the ingredients I need to buy?
 On the main Nutrition screen, tap "Manage" inside your active plan's card. Then select "Grocery List". We will show you all the ingredients grouped by category.

### The grocery list has things I already have in my pantry, can I share only what I'm missing with my partner?
 Totally. On the Grocery List screen, tap the "Select" button in the top right. This will allow you to check only the ingredients you are missing. Then, tap the Share icon and CaloriTrack will generate a clean text with only your selection to send via WhatsApp or any other app.

### In the Plan Assistant, can I choose a Ketogenic (Keto) diet and be Dairy-Free at the same time?
 Yes. The assistant is designed to combine your preferences. In step 3 you choose your restrictions (e.g., Dairy-Free) and in step 4 you select the diet style (e.g., Ketogenic Diet). The system will filter the database and recommend in the final step only the plans that strictly meet both conditions.-----

# Nombre del archivo: docs/03-ayuno/guia-ayuno.mdx

# Descripci√≥n: Gu√≠a detallada del m√≥dulo de ayuno. Incluye configuraci√≥n, uso del anillo interactivo, gesti√≥n de historial y secci√≥n de dudas frecuentes (FAQs) integradas.

title: "Ultimate Guide: Master Your Fast"
sidebar_label: "Master Your Fast"

---

Welcome to your fasting control center! This screen is designed to accompany you through every step of your process, from your first 12 hours to advanced challenges. Here we explain how to use all its tools:

## 1. Set Your Preferences (The First Step)

Before getting started, let's personalize your experience! In the upper left corner of the main fasting screen, you will see a **settings icon** (sliders).

Tap it to open your preferences. There you can:
* Set your **default hour goal** (from 12 up to 96 hours).
* Set your **usual start and end times** so the app adapts organically to your daily routine.

## 2. The Magic Ring (Your Interactive Timer)

In the center of the screen, you'll see a large circular ring. It's fully interactive!

* **Quick adjustment:** You can tap and drag the "dot" (indicator) along the ring to increase or decrease your goal hours in real-time.
* **Learn while you adjust:** As you slide your finger, small on-screen messages will appear explaining exactly what is happening in your body at that hour (e.g., *"16 hours: Accelerated fat burning"*).
* **Clear information:** In the center of the ring, you will always see your remaining time in large numbers, along with your total goal and elapsed time.

:::tip CaloriTrack Wisdom
The ring is not just a clock; it is a map of your physiology. Pay attention to the cellular stage messages to understand your biological progress.
:::

## 3. Start, Edit, and Share

* **Kick it off!:** Tap the large button at the bottom to start your fast.
* **Forgot to tap start?:** Don't worry. Once your fast is running, you will see a **pencil icon** next to the phrase "Fast started." Tap it to adjust the exact date and time you actually stopped eating.
* **Show off your achievement:** When you have a fast in progress, a **Share icon** will appear at the bottom. You can generate an elegant image with custom backgrounds for Instagram or WhatsApp.
* **End:** Use the main button again to record the end of your fast.

## 4. Education and Benefits

You are not alone on this journey; the app teaches you as you go.

* **The benefits of your effort:** In the upper right corner, tap the **information icon ("i")**. It will open a detailed list of physiological benefits separated by stages (from 12 hours to prolonged 96-hour fasts).
* **Beginner's guide:** If you don't have an active fast, you'll see a button with a **question mark** at the bottom. It's a quick, step-by-step guide to ensure your first fast is a complete success.

## 5. History and Statistics

Just below your fasting ring, you will see a card congratulating you on your **Current Streak**. Tap it to enter your stats dashboard!

* **Your Records:** View your KPIs such as your longest fast, your maximum streak, and average hours.
* **Charts:** See your progress on a bar chart filterable by week, month, or year.
* **Full Log:** You will find a list of all your historical fasts. If you long-press one, you can **Edit** the hours if you made a mistake or **Delete** it if it was a test entry.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### What can I consume without breaking autophagy?
During your fasting window, the goal is to keep insulin low. You can consume:
* Still or sparkling water.
* Black coffee and tea (no sweeteners).
* Hydration salts (glucose-free) available in the app.
* **Avoid:** Any food with calories or artificial sweeteners.

### Why did my timer change time on its own?
CaloriTrack is a comprehensive health tool. If you log a meal in your **Food Diary** during an hour when you were supposedly fasting, the app will automatically adjust the start of your fast to maintain the integrity of your biological data. Honesty with your data is the key to self-knowledge!

:::info Technical Note
Remember that for perfect synchronization, it is recommended to allow notification permissions so that CaloriTrack can notify you when you reach your cellular goals.
:::

### How do I start my fasting timer?

It's very simple! When you enter the **Fasting** tab (the clock icon in the bottom menu), you will see a large central circle with your hour goal. Simply adjust the hours by sliding your finger along the edge of the circle and press the large button that says **"Start Fasting"** at the bottom.

### I forgot to tap "Start" when I finished eating. Can I change the start time?

Yes, of course! Don't worry if you missed the exact time. Once you have started your fast in the app, you will see a text below the circle that says *"Fast started"* with the current time. Tap the **pencil icon** next to that time, and you can retroactively select the exact date and time you actually began your fast.

### How do I stop my fast if I'm ready to eat?

When you are ready to break your fast, go to the main view and tap the gold button that says **"End Fasting"**. The app will record the total time you achieved, update your stats, and show you a congratulatory screen with your new streak.

### I ended my fast early, does it still save?

The application is designed to help you build habits. If you stop your fast before reaching your goal, the record will only be saved in your history if more than **10 seconds** have passed. This prevents accidental taps from being saved. However, remember that to maintain your "Streak," it is best to reach the goal you set for yourself.

---

## üéØ Custom Goals and Preferences

### How do I change my hour goal while fasting?

If you are already in the middle of a fast and decide you want to lengthen or shorten it, simply place your finger on the "dot" (indicator) on the edge of the circle and slide it. You will see the hour goal update in real-time. You will also see that the time your *"Fast ends"* adjusts automatically at the bottom.

### I want to do an extended fast, what is the hour limit in the app?

Our app supports everything from classic intermittent fasts (12 or 16 hours) to extended fasts. You can spin the circle to set a goal of **up to 96 hours**.

### Do I have to set my hours every time I start a fast?

It is not necessary. If you have a fixed protocol (e.g., 16 hours every day), you can tap the **settings icon** (the three lines with sliders) in the upper left corner of the Fasting screen. There you can define:

* Your default hour goal (e.g., 16 hours).
* Your usual start time (e.g., 8:00 PM).
* Your calculated end time (e.g., 12:00 PM).

Once saved, every time you open the app, your circle will already be set to that goal.

---

## üé® The Progress Circle and Colors

### Why does the elapsed time text change color?

The color of your fasting time is a visual indicator of the metabolic phase you are currently in:

* üüß **Soft Orange (0 to 12 hours):** Your body is processing your last meal and using glycogen.
* üü© **Mint Green (12 to 16 hours):** Fat burning and early ketosis begin.
* üü¶ **Sky Blue (16 to 20 hours):** Fat burning increases, and autophagy may start.
* üü™ **Purple (Over 20 hours):** Deep autophagy phase and maximum cellular repair.

### I met my hour goal, but the timer keeps counting. What does the "+" sign mean?

When you reach your goal (the circle fills completely), the app does not automatically stop you, as you might decide to keep going a little longer. From that moment on, you will see the text change to *"Time exceeded"* and it will show you a timer with a **"+" sign** (e.g., `+45 m` or `+2 h`). This indicates exactly how much extra time you achieved beyond your original target.

## üìö Learning and Guides

### I'm new to intermittent fasting. Do you have tips to get started?

Absolutely! If you haven't started your fast yet, you will see a button with a **question mark (?)** at the bottom. Tapping it will open the *"Quick Guide for Beginners"*, where you will learn about hydration, what breaks a fast, how to manage hunger, and what to eat when you finish.

### While fasting, I want to know what is happening to my body.

In the top right corner of the main screen, you will see a button with an **"i" (Information)**. Tap there to open the *"Fasting Benefits"* section. It will show you a detailed timeline (from 0 to 96 hours) explaining how your body behaves at each stage (fat burning, ketosis, autophagy, etc.).

---

## üìä History and Statistics

### Where can I see how many consecutive days I've fasted?

Tap the stats card that appears just below the progress circle on the main view. This will take you to the **Fasting Stats** screen. There you will see your *"Current streak"* (consecutive days meeting your goal) and your *"Longest historical streak"*.

### What other metrics can I see in the statistics section?

Within your stats, you can view:

* Your current streak and historical record.
* The longest fast you have achieved.
* Your average hours per fast.
* The total number of fasts completed.
* An interactive bar chart that you can filter by Week, Month, or Year.

### I ended my fast yesterday, but I forgot to tap "End" in the app and it saved way too many hours. Can I fix it?

Yes! Go to the Stats screen and scroll down to the **"Full Log"** section. Find the fast you want to correct, long-press on it, and select **"Edit"**. You will be able to manually adjust the exact date and time you ended it.

### Can I keep a journal of how I felt during each fast?

Of course. In the same *"Edit"* option mentioned above, you will find a text box for **"Personal Notes"**. You can use it to write down if you had high energy, felt hungry, or what you ate to break your fast.

### What does the "People fasting right now" box in my stats mean?

It is a global summary that shows you how many CaloriTrack community members are in the middle of a fast right at this very moment. You are never alone on your journey to wellness!

---

## üì≤ Sharing Your Achievements

### I'm halfway through my fast and want to share my progress. Is it possible?

Yes! While your fast is in progress, you will see a button with a **share icon** (a box with an upward arrow) in the bottom left of the screen. Tapping it will generate an elegant image showing how much time you have left and your current goal. You can choose different background colors and share it directly on your social networks or via message.

### I completed my 24-hour fast! How do I show it off?

When you press *"End Fasting"*, a congratulatory screen will appear with a summary of your streak and time achieved. On that same screen, you will see the **"Share your achievement"** button. You can customize the *"Fast Completed"* commemorative image and send it to your friends to inspire them to join you.-----

## üîê Access and Availability

### Why do I see a screen asking me to upgrade my plan when I try to open Kai?

Kai Coach is your smart assistant and an exclusive tool for Premium members. If you currently have the free version of the app, or if your subscription has expired, you will see an informative screen indicating that you must get Premium to chat with Kai.

---

## üí¨ Starting a Conversation

### It's my first time here and I don't know what to ask. How do I start?

Don't worry! When you open Kai and the chat is empty, the initial screen will show you three default question suggestions to break the ice. If you tap any of those buttons, the question will be automatically typed and sent so Kai can start helping you.

### What language can I speak to Kai in?
You can type in the language of your choice. Additionally, Kai is programmed to detect the main language configured on your mobile phone and will respond fluently in that same language.

---

## ‚úçÔ∏è Typing and Sending Messages

### Why does the text box get bigger when I type?
We want it to be comfortable for you to explain your doubts to Kai. That's why the text box automatically expands upwards as you type longer or multi-line messages, up to a maximum size so as not to cover the rest of the screen.

### Why does the send button (the paper airplane) appear disabled or gray sometimes?
The send button is disabled to protect the app's fluidity in two situations:
* If you haven't typed anything in the text box or if you only put blank spaces.
* While Kai is "typing" and processing a response for you. You will notice that it's thinking because you'll see a blinking three-dot animation along with some sparks.

### I typed a message and the keyboard disappeared immediately, is this normal?

Yes! By pressing the send button, we automatically hide the keyboard to give you a wide, clean view of the screen while you wait and read Kai's response.

---

## üß† Chat Memory and History

### Does Kai remember what I said in previous messages?
Yes, Kai is a conversational assistant. To keep the thread of the conversation and give you responses with context, Kai remembers and analyzes the last 15 messages sent in your current session.

### I want to start from scratch and talk about a completely different topic. How do I clear the chat?
In the upper right corner of your screen, you will see a square icon with a pencil. Tapping it will bring up a prompt asking for confirmation to start a new conversation. If you accept, the entire current chat history will be cleared from the screen to give you a blank canvas. Please note that this action is final and cannot be undone.

---

## üõ°Ô∏è Privacy and Health

### Is it safe to share my data and habits with Kai?
Absolutely. On the initial screen (before sending messages), you will see a privacy note with a shield icon. All the information you share with Kai is confidential and processed under strict security standards.

### I feel physically unwell, can Kai give me a diagnosis or treatment?
No. Kai is a wellness and nutrition coach, but not a doctor. On the main screen, you will always see a medical disclaimer reminding you of this. Kai's responses should never replace the advice, diagnosis, or treatment of a qualified healthcare professional.

---

## ‚ö†Ô∏è Errors and Troubleshooting

### I tried to send a message and Kai replied: "You do not have enough credits". What does this mean if I already paid for Premium?
Artificial intelligence requires processing power. If you ever see this message, it means you have exhausted the quota or limit of interactions allowed with Kai according to your current plan.

### The message says: "Kai is not available at the moment". What do I do?
This is a temporary error that occurs if you lose your internet connection or if Kai's servers are under maintenance. Simply wait a few minutes, check your WiFi or data connection, and try again.

---

## üèÜ Rewards for Using Kai

### Does talking to Kai help me complete my habits in the app?
Yes! Every interaction you have is automatically logged. In your "My Path" section, you will see that the "Connection with Kai" habit will light up on the days you chat with him. Plus, you will collect exclusive badges (Badges); from your first message, to reaching milestones of 10, 30, 50, 100, 200, and 500 chats. It's a great way to make progress!-----

# Meet Kai: Your Smart Coach in CaloriTrack

Kai is your personal, smart nutrition and wellness assistant, integrated directly into CaloriTrack. Designed to offer you support, answer your questions, and motivate you on your journey to a healthier life, Kai is like having an expert in your pocket available 24 hours a day.

Through a fluid and friendly chat interface, you can talk to Kai in your own language to receive personalized advice, meal ideas, or simply a motivational boost when you need it most.

---

## Complete Usage Guide: Screen by Screen

To ensure you get 100% out of what Kai has to offer, we have divided this guide to detail every corner of its interface.

### üö™ Access and Home Screen

When you tap the Kai icon (the magical sparkles) in the bottom navigation bar, you will enter its dedicated section.

:::info Exclusive Premium Access
The first thing you should know is that Kai is an exclusive feature for our Premium users. If you do not yet have an active subscription, the screen will show our elegant Paywall inviting you to upgrade your plan to unlock access.
:::

* **The Header:** At the top of the screen, you will see the official CaloriTrack logo centered, welcoming you.

---

### üåü The Initial State (Before chatting)

If it is your first time talking to Kai or if you have just started a new conversation, you will see a clean and friendly welcome screen designed to break the ice:

* **Welcome:** In the center of the screen, you will be greeted by a blue sparkles icon, followed by a welcome title and a brief explanatory subtitle.
* **Quick Suggestions (Shortcuts):** To make things easier for you, Kai presents three buttons with suggested questions or topics. If you tap any of these suggestions, the text will be sent automatically as your first message, starting the conversation without you having to type a single word.
* **Privacy Notice:** At the bottom, you will find a padlock icon along with a privacy notice, guaranteeing that your data is 100% safe and secure.

:::caution Important Medical Disclaimer
Right below the privacy notice, you will see a fundamental reminder: although Kai is very smart and based on scientific evidence, **its advice does not replace the opinion, diagnosis, or treatment of a qualified healthcare professional.**
:::

---

### ‚å®Ô∏è Typing and Interacting

The bottom part of the screen is dedicated to your direct interaction with Kai:

* **The Message Bar:** Here you will see a text box with a prompt inviting you to type (e.g., *"Type a message..."*). When you tap it, your keyboard will intelligently deploy, gently pushing the chat upwards so you never lose sight of what you are typing.
* **The Send Button:** To the right of the text box, there is a circular **Mint Green** button with a paper airplane icon. This button will remain disabled (gray) if the text box is empty. Once you type something, it will become active.
* **Hide the Keyboard:** If you decide not to send a message or want a better view of the chat history, simply tap any empty part of the chat background, and the keyboard will smoothly hide automatically.

---

### üí¨ Conversation Dynamics

Once you send your first message, the initial screen will disappear to make way for your chat history:

* **Your Messages:** Everything you type will appear aligned to the right side of the screen, inside light blue chat bubbles, allowing you to easily identify your questions.
* **Kai's Responses:** These will appear aligned to the left, inside gray bubbles, and always accompanied by its distinctive circular sparkle icon.
* **Smart Language:** Don't worry about the language! Kai automatically detects the language your device is set to and will respond to you in that same language.
* **"Typing..." Indicator:** Since Kai processes a lot of information to give you the best answer, it sometimes takes a few seconds to think. During this brief moment, you will see an animated indicator with three bouncing dots (`...`), letting you know that Kai is working for you.
* **Auto-Scroll:** As the conversation gets longer, the screen will automatically scroll down every time you send a message or when Kai finishes typing its response.

---

### üîÑ Resetting and Managing your Chat

Kai remembers the context of your current conversation (up to your last 15 messages) to give you coherent answers. If you want to radically change the topic or start from scratch:

1. **New Conversation Button:** In the upper right corner of the screen (on the top bar), you will see an icon of a square with a pencil.
2. **Clear Confirmation:** When you tap this button, a security alert will appear asking if you are sure you want to start a new conversation. The alert will warn you that this action will clear the current chat history and cannot be undone.

If you confirm, the chat will be completely cleared, and you will see the Initial Welcome Screen with the quick suggestions again.

---

### ‚ö†Ô∏è Special Considerations (Limits and Errors)

To maintain optimal service, there are a couple of situations that the Kai view handles gracefully:

* **Usage Limit:** If at any time you reach the limit of queries allowed by your plan, Kai will respond with a polite message indicating that you do not have enough credits at the moment and will suggest checking your account options.
* **Connection Issues:** If there is a failure in our servers or problems with your internet connection, Kai will notify you that it is *"not available at the moment"* and will ask you to try again later, displaying this notice as a normal message within the conversation so as not to disrupt your experience.-----

## üß≠ General Access and Exploration

### Why do I see a screen asking me to upgrade my plan when I try to enter the Wellness tab?
The entire catalog of meditations, frequencies, and breathing exercises in the Wellness tab is exclusive content. To play and explore this material, an active Premium membership on your Caloritrack account is required.

### There is a lot of content, how can I quickly find something specific for how I feel today?
You have two very quick ways to filter the content:

* **Search bar:** At the top, there is a text bar where you can type keywords (e.g., "anxiety" or "sleep"), and the list will update automatically.
* **Quick Filters (Chips):** Just below the search bar, you will see oval buttons with categories like "Sleep," "Relaxation," or "Focus" (if you are in Soundhealing), or "Reduce stress," "Energy," etc. (if you are in Breathwork). Tap any of them to see only the exercises in that category.

### How do I save the audios or exercises I like the most so I don't have to search for them every time?
You can save any exercise to your "Favorites" by tapping the star icon that appears on the exercise card directly in the list. If you are already inside the sound player, you can tap the heart icon in the top right corner. To see everything you have saved, select the "Favorites" filter on the main Wellness screen.

---

## üéß Soundhealing

### When tapping an audio, it sends me to an information screen instead of playing immediately. Why?
That is the Preview screen. It is designed to give you context before your session. There you can see the sound category, a short description, and a deeper explanation of how that frequency or sound will help you. You will also see a reminder to use headphones, which we recommend for the best benefits. Just tap "Play Now" at the bottom to start the audio.

### What do the controls inside the sound player mean?
The player has tools to customize your session:

* **Central Button (Play/Pause):** Stops or resumes the main track.
* **Timer (clock icon):** Allows you to set a specific time (e.g., 15 or 30 minutes) for the audio to turn off automatically, ideal if you use it to sleep.
* **AirPlay (concentric screens icon):** Allows you to send the audio to your smart speakers, HomePod, or Apple TV.
* **Repeat (looping arrows icon):** You can set it so the audio stops when the track ends, repeats once, or repeats infinitely.

### Can I play rain or wind sounds in the background while listening to my sound therapy?
Yes! We have unified the volume and ambient controls into a single card inside the player. Below the main track volume control, you will see a section called "Ambience". Tapping the "+" icon will open a menu where you can choose between options like stream, rain, forest, wind, storm, among others. Once selected, you can adjust the volume of that ambient sound independently from the main track.

### If I use AirPlay to listen on my HomePod, will the ambient sound (e.g., rain) I added also be heard?
Yes. The app's audio system is optimized (Dual AirPlay Support) to mix both audios (the Soundhealing track and the ambience) and send them together to your external device seamlessly.

### I minimized the player to navigate the app. How do I open it again or remove it?
While navigating, you will see a mini-player at the bottom of the screen. If you tap any part of it, it will reopen in full screen. If you decide to "swipe" it to the left, it will collapse into a small side tab so it doesn't get in your way.
---
## üå¨Ô∏è Breathwork

### How should I follow the pace of the breathing exercise?
The screen will guide you in three ways:

* **Visually:** A Mint Green central circle will expand when you need to inhale, stay still when you need to hold the air, and contract when you need to exhale.
* **By text:** In the center of the circle you will see clear instructions ("Inhale", "Hold", "Exhale", "Hold") along with a real-time seconds counter.
* **Vibrations (Haptics):** You will feel pulsations on your device that vary in intensity to guide you without having to look at the screen.

### The vibrations (haptics) distract me, can I turn them off?
Of course. At the bottom right of the breathing player, you will find a button with a phone icon. Tap it to disable (or re-enable) the haptic feedback.

### How do I know how much time is left to finish my breathing session?
You have two indicators. At the top there is a linear progress bar and a timer showing the total remaining minutes. At the bottom, you will see the current number of "Cycles" versus the total (e.g., "2/5"), which helps you know which repetition you are on.

---

## üìä History, Sync & Stats

### If I do a Soundhealing or Breathwork exercise, is it saved in my history?
Yes! As long as the audio or breathing session lasted more than 10 continuous seconds, the system will automatically register it as completed.

### Does all this connect with the Health app (Apple Health) on my iPhone?
Absolutely. The Wellness module syncs bidirectionally with Apple Health.

* Your Soundhealing and Breathwork sessions are automatically sent as "Mindfulness Minutes" to Apple Health.
* Your Mood logs, if you have iOS 17 or higher, are sent directly to the new native "State of Mind" section of Apple Health with their valence level (positive/negative). If you have an older iOS, it is alternatively registered as a general mindfulness log.-----

Welcome to the **Wellness** section, your personal sanctuary designed to restore your mental, emotional, and physical balance. In a world full of noise and stress, this space has been carefully crafted to offer you clinical and therapeutic-grade tools that will help you disconnect, focus, or prepare for deep sleep.

## 1. Getting Started: Access and Main Exploration

To enter this ecosystem, simply tap the Wellness icon (the meditating figure) on your app's bottom navigation bar.

:::info Premium Access
This is an exclusive experience for Premium subscribers. If you are not Premium yet, you will see a screen inviting you to unlock all of its benefits.
:::

Once inside, you'll notice that the main screen is designed to be intuitive and easy to navigate:

* **Section Selector (Top Tabs):** At the top, you will see a switch to quickly toggle between *Soundhealing* and *Breathwork*.
* **Search Bar:** Looking for something specific? Use the bar with the magnifying glass to type keywords (e.g., *"Rain"*, *"Sleep"*, *"Stress"*) and quickly find your ideal session.

## 2. Auditory Magic: The Soundhealing Module

When you select a Soundhealing track, you enter an immersive player designed to soothe your senses.

### üëÅÔ∏è The Preview
Before starting, you will see a screen with the sound's cover art, its category, and a detailed description of its benefits. If it sounds right for you, tap the large green **"Play Now"** button.

### üì± The Full-Screen Player
Once playing, the screen will subtly darken to protect your eyes (ideal for nighttime). Here you have total control:

* **Central Button (Play/Pause):** Tap the mint green circle in the center to pause or resume your track.
* **Favorite (Heart):** In the top right corner, tap the heart to add or remove the track from your favorites at any time.
* **Minimize (Down Arrow):** In the top left corner, tap the arrow to hide the player. The music will keep playing while you browse other parts of CaloriTrack!

### üõ†Ô∏è Advanced Player Tools
Right next to the Play/Pause button, you will find three key controls:

1. **Timer (Clock Icon):** Going to sleep? Tap this icon to set an auto-turn-off timer. You can use the wheel to choose exact hours and minutes, or use the quick access buttons (15, 30, 45, or 60 minutes). The music will stop on its own so it won't drain your battery while you sleep.
2. **AirPlay:** Tap this icon to send the surround sound to your Apple TV, HomePod, or any compatible smart speaker.
3. **Repeat (Loop - Infinity/Arrows Icon):** Tap to toggle between three modes:
   * **Off:** The track stops when it finishes.
   * **Repeat once (1):** It plays again only one more time.
   * **Infinity (‚àû):** Ideal for sleeping, the track will loop all night long.

### üéõÔ∏è Unified Card: Volume and Ambience
At the bottom, you will see a special card that is the crown jewel of Soundhealing: the dual mixer.

* **Main Volume:** Use the first slider to adjust the volume of the main melody.
* **Add Ambience (The "+" button):** Tap the button with the "+" symbol (or the leaf icon) to open the Ambience Mixer. Here you can choose from a library of high-fidelity natural sounds: Rain, Ocean Waves, Campfire, Strong Wind, Forest, Waterfall, among others.
* **Perfect Mix:** Once an ambience is chosen, use the second slider to exclusively adjust the volume of the rain or forest, creating the perfect mix alongside the main melody. If you want to remove the ambience, just tap the small "X"!

### ü™ü The Dynamic Mini-Player
If you minimize the player to go look at your macros or your fast, you will see a "Mini Player" floating at the bottom of the screen.

* It has quick Play/Pause and AirPlay controls.
* **Smart Hiding:** If you feel it's in the way on the screen, simply swipe the mini-player to the left. It will hide in a small tab on the edge of your screen. Tap that tab to expand it again.

---

## 3. Lung Power: The Breathwork Module

Conscious breathing is your remote control for the nervous system. Select the top "Breathwork" tab and choose an exercise (for example, for "Better Sleep" or "Energy").

### ü´Å Animated Breathing Interface
Upon starting, the screen transforms into a minimalist environment. You will see a pulsating central circle and dynamic colors:

* **Follow the Circle:** The mint green circle will expand when you should Inhale and contract when you should Exhale.
* **Clear Instructions:** In the center of the circle, you will read exactly what to do (Inhale, Hold, Exhale, Hold) accompanied by a real-time seconds countdown in large numbers.

### ‚èØÔ∏è Session Controls
* **Play/Stop Button:** At the bottom, tap the large circular button to start the exercise. If you need to stop halfway through, tap it again (it will turn red to stop).
* **Progress:** At the top, you will see a bar indicating how much time is left to complete the entire session, plus a "Cycles" counter (e.g., 1/5) at the bottom.
* **Haptic Vibration (The iPhone icon):** Next to the Play button, there is a vibrating phone icon. When activated, your iPhone will emit subtle pulses synchronized with the breathing. This is incredible if you prefer to close your eyes; the vibration will guide you, telling you when to inhale and when to exhale without having to look at the screen.

---

## 4. Mood Tracking

Although accessed from the app's Header, tracking your emotional state is a vital piece of your Wellness ecosystem.

* **How to enter?** From the My Body (Health) or Nutrition screen, simply tap today's date in the top left corner.
* **Mood Selector:** A bright color slider will appear. Move it from left (Very Bad / Purple) to right (Very Good / Orange). The smiley face and icon will change to reflect your selection.
* **Identify the Factors:** Once you've chosen how you feel, tap "Next". A dropdown menu will open with categories: Life, Health, Work, and Activities. Select which things (Family, Sleep, Money, etc.) are influencing your day.
* **Private Notes:** There is a text box in case you want to write a short journal entry or thought about why you feel this way.
* **History and Kai's Support:** Your logs will be saved in a timeline list. If you ever record a negative mood ("Bad" or "Very Bad"), CaloriTrack will show you a special "Kai Coach" button inviting you to chat with your artificial intelligence, who will be ready to offer you support, Stoic advice, or simply listen to you.-----

Archivo: ./src/theme/Root.js
// Nombre del archivo: src/theme/Root.js
// Autor: Arturo Enriquez Betancourt con Jarvis
// Fecha: 2026-05-13
// Versi√≥n: 1.3
// Descripci√≥n: Componente Root devuelto de forma √≠ntegra basado en tu versi√≥n proporcionada. Mantiene la l√≥gica impecable de visibilidad del buscador (oculto en Home mediante 'is-home-page') y el modal de contacto. No requiere cambios l√≥gicos adicionales para el centrado del buscador.

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from '@docusaurus/router';

export default function Root({children}) {
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const location = useLocation();

  // Detectamos si estamos en el Home (soporta ra√≠z y versi√≥n en ingl√©s)
  const isHomePage = location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/en' || location.pathname === '/en/';

  useEffect(() => {
    // 1. Gesti√≥n de clase para ocultar buscador en el Header
    if (isHomePage) {
      document.body.classList.add('is-home-page');
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove('is-home-page');
    }

    // 2. Interceptor de clics para el Modal de Contacto
    const handleClick = (e) => {
      const target = e.target.closest('a');
      if (target && target.getAttribute('href') === '#contacto') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setIsModalOpen(true);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('click', handleClick);
      document.body.classList.remove('is-home-page'); // Limpieza al desmontar
    };
  }, [isHomePage]);

  const closeModal = () => setIsModalOpen(false);

  return (
    <>
      {children}

      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="contact-modal-overlay" onClick={closeModal}>
          <div className="contact-modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <button className="contact-modal-close" onClick={closeModal} aria-label="Cerrar modal">&times;</button>
            
            <div className="contact-modal-header">
              <h2>¬øEn qu√© podemos ayudarte?</h2>
              <p>Cu√©ntanos qu√© sucede. Nuestro equipo revisar√° tu mensaje y te responder√° lo m√°s pronto posible para que sigas potenciando tu bienestar.</p>
            </div>
            
            <iframe 
              src="https://caloritrack.com/contacto-soporte-iframe" 
              title="Formulario de Contacto Caloritrack"
              className="contact-modal-iframe"
              frameBorder="0"
            ></iframe>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}-----
